outcome: uroflowmetry (maximum flow rate, average flow rate, voided volume)
cohort: A 32-year-old female patient diagnosed with overactive bladder (OAB) who experienced frequent urination for 15 years.
finding: Electroacupuncture treatment led to significant improvements in the patient's OAB symptoms, bladder function (reduced PVR, increased voided volume, improved flow rates), and quality of life (decreased OABSS and KHQ scores).
